record.description_evidence:
Foodbok makes food tracking simple. Snap a photo, scan a barcode, or log meals in seconds. Foodbok is built on nutrition science and uses AI to help you eat better — without stress. With Foodbok, you can lose weight, build muscle, or maintain balance at your own pace — without strict diets or yo-yo effects. 

Instead of restrictions, Foodbok focuses on awareness and balance. It helps you understand cravings, weight plateaus, and energy changes, so you can build healthier habits that last. 


How Foodbok works: 

1. Track calories 
Snap a photo, log meals manually, or scan a barcode. Get food analysis in seconds — without guessing. 

2. Follow your personalized daily plan 
We calculate your calorie needs based on your goals and habits, helping you stay on track every day. 

3. Get smart recommendations 
Understand what your body needs and make better choices with guidance tailored to you — like a personal nutrition coach. 


Foodbok — all-in-one app: 

• AI meal photo scanner, barcode scanner, and manual food logging 
• Personalized daily calorie and nutrition recommendations 
• Food database covering 97% of everyday foods 
• In-depth macro and micronutrient analysis 
(46 nutrients, including vitamins and minerals) 
• Tracking for water intake, vitamins and medications, and physical activity — with reminders 
• Body measurements tracker: weight, waist, and more 
• Create and save your own recipes 
• 100+ easy-to-prepare recipes 
• Full sync with Apple Health and Apple Watch 
• Ad-free experience with no distractions 
• All your health data — in one place 

 
Availability:

Foodbok offers essential features for free. 
Start with a 7-day free trial to explore all features without limits — snap photos of your meals, receive personalized guidance, and make progress toward your goals more effectively. 

If Foodbok feels right for you, unlock the full PRO experience with a 3-, 6-, or 12-month subscription. 

We want to become the best app for you, so we’d love to hear your feedback: support@foodbok.com

COPYMIND — Your AI-Powered Second Mind

Need a place to untangle thoughts, make confident decisions, and keep moving forward? COPYMIND builds a personalized AI twin from your real words, patterns, and goals—so you always have a clear-thinking partner in your pocket.

How COPYMIND helps you grow
* Daily Reflections
Short, insight-packed prompts surface blind spots, celebrate wins, and strengthen self-awareness—no journaling discipline required.
* Decider
Break any choice—from “Should I switch careers?” to “Muffin or no muffin?”—into bite-size factors. See probability-based outcomes or let your twin suggest options you hadn’t considered.
* MindCores
Visualize a live 3D map of your values, fears, habits, and relationships. Watch it evolve as you interact, revealing hidden connections that shape your decisions.
* Long-form Readings
Receive deep-dive essays on topics like procrastination, boundaries, or imposter syndrome—generated specifically for you, packed with actionable insights.
* Always-On Chat
Talk to your AI twin any time you feel stuck, overwhelmed, or curious. It remembers your history, speaks in a tone that resonates, and never judges or ghosts you.

Why thousands choose COPYMIND
* Clarity on demand – Swap looping thoughts for structured insight in minutes.
* Personal, not generic – Guidance is grounded in your own language and life events.
* Proactive support – Your twin nudges you with timely questions, summaries, and encouragement.
* Private & secure – End-to-end encryption, no ads, and data that never leaves our encrypted cloud.
* Lightweight routine – Just a few minutes a day brings measurable clarity and momentum.

Made for everyday use
* Works on iPhone and iPad; syncs across devices.
* Gentle notifications keep you on track without adding noise.
* Dark Mode and large-text friendly.

Disclaimer
COPYMIND is a self-reflection and decision-support tool. It does **not** provide medical or psychological diagnosis, treatment, or advice. For professional mental-health care, please consult a licensed practitioner.

Unlock clearer thinking, faster decisions, and a kinder relationship with your own mind—download COPYMIND today and meet your AI-powered self.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Transform your health journey with Reflect, your personal wellness companion powered by Puff—an AI assistant that helps you understand and improve your overall health.

YOUR DAILY WELLNESS SCORE
Get a personalized health score from 1-1000 that reflects your overall wellness. Your score is calculated from multiple factors:
• Sleep quality and duration (7-9 hours ideal)
• Activity levels (steps, workouts, active energy)
• Recovery metrics (heart rate variability, resting heart rate)
• Mood and event tracking throughout your day
• Consistency in maintaining healthy habits

MEET PUFF, YOUR AI COMPANION
Puff is your friendly AI health companion that provides personalized insights and recommendations. Ask Puff questions like:
• "How can I improve my score?"
• "How can I sleep better?"
• "What should I do today?"
• "Any tips for recovery?"

Puff uses Apple Intelligence for on-device AI processing, so all your conversations stay private on your device.

COMPREHENSIVE HEALTH TRACKING
Track everything that matters to your wellness:
• Sleep: Automatic tracking via HealthKit
• Activity: Steps, workouts, active energy
• Recovery: HRV, resting heart rate
• Mood: Log how you're feeling throughout the day
• Mindfulness: Track meditation and breathing exercises
• Nutrition: Log meals and calories
• Journal: Record your daily reflections

DETAILED INSIGHTS & TRENDS
• See what's affecting your score with detailed breakdowns
• View trends over daily, weekly, and monthly periods
• Track progress with achievements and milestones
• Understand your health patterns with visual charts

PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN
Your privacy is our top priority. All your health data stays on your device:
• HealthKit data never leaves your iPhone
• On-device AI processing—no cloud AI services
• No health data stored in the cloud
• You own your data—delete anytime

AVAILABLE IN 13 LANGUAGES
Reflect supports English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Korean, Arabic, Russian, and Hindi.

FEATURES
• Daily wellness score (1–1000) with clear wellness bands
• AI companion for personalized insights
• Automatic HealthKit integration
• Mood tracking with customizable moods
• Activity and workout logging
• Sleep and recovery metrics
• Optional astrology-inspired reflection prompts
• Nutrition tracking
• Journal for daily reflections and intention setting
• Trend analysis (daily, weekly, monthly)
• Achievements and milestones
• Beautiful, intuitive interface
• Full accessibility support

Start your wellness journey today with Reflect and Puff. Understand your health, track your progress, and discover actionable insights to improve your overall wellness.

record.description_evidence:
Phrenly isn't a generic chatbot with therapy prompts. It's a purpose-built wellness partner grounded in the same evidence-based frameworks clinicians use — CBT, DBT, and ACT — available the moment you need it.

TALK IT THROUGH
Chat or speak with Phrenly anytime. It remembers what matters to you, suggests the right exercise at the right moment, and always meets you with warmth — at 2pm or 2am.

A PARTNER THAT FITS YOU
Choose how Phrenly relates to you — Warm & Gentle, Direct & Grounded, Reflective & Open, or Culturally Attuned. The support that helps most is the support that feels right, so you set the tone.

REAL THERAPEUTIC TOOLS
Guided, structured exercises from clinical practice: thought records, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, box breathing, values clarification, and personalized coping plans. Not just conversation — practice.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Daily mood check-ins build your emotional trajectory. Track streaks, review your history, and get gentle weekly reflections on how your week actually went.

BUILT SAFETY-FIRST
Phrenly monitors every conversation for signs of crisis and responds immediately with support resources, including 988. Crisis support is never limited and never paywalled.

DAILY REMINDERS
A gentle nudge at the time you choose, so self-care becomes a habit.

FREE TO START

record.description_evidence:
Welta brings sleep, activity, meals, mood, and recovery into one clear view of your day. See what changed, explore the patterns behind it, and choose a practical next step.

UNDERSTAND YOUR DAY
Daily Balance connects sleep, activity, and nutrition so you can see the whole picture. Open each area to explore the signals behind your scores. With your permission, Welta uses supported data from Apple Health to show your steps, workouts, sleep, and other available metrics in context.

EXPLORE YOUR PATTERNS
Follow sleep duration, stages, consistency, sleep debt, and readiness context. Review activity trends, workout highlights, heart rate, VO2 max and progress toward your goals. Log your mood and hydration alongside the rest of your day.

LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
Add meals manually, with text, or from a photo. Review AI-assisted nutrition estimates before saving. See calories, macros, and meal timing in one place.

ASK WELTA AI
Ask about your recent patterns, get plain-language explanations, and draft a plan for today. Suggested actions stay under your control and require your confirmation before they are saved.

TRY A CHANGE BEFORE YOU COMMIT
Use Time Machine to explore how a possible routine change might affect your daily signals compared with your recent baseline. Its estimates show direction, not guaranteed or medical outcomes.

BUILD MOMENTUM
Set adjustable goals and try focused seven-day challenges based on your recent patterns. Follow your progress as your routine takes shape.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
Core wellness analysis starts on your device. Optional cloud AI processes information for the features you choose to use after you enable it and accept the in-app data-sharing agreement. Welta does not use Apple Health data for advertising.

WELTA PREMIUM
Welta offers auto-renewing monthly and yearly Premium subscriptions. Eligible new subscribers can try the monthly plan for free. If a free trial applies, billing begins when it ends unless canceled beforehand. Otherwise, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Welta is for general wellness and fitness purposes. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or emergency guidance.

Terms of Use: https://welta.co/terms/

record.description_evidence:
Your watch knows how you slept. Your scale knows what you weigh. Your gym app knows what you lifted. None of them talk to each other, and none will tell you what to do about it. Wellness Project does both.

It pulls your training, nutrition, hydration, sleep, recovery, vital signs, labs, body composition, and more into one place, then hands that picture to eight AI specialists who read your real data and tell you exactly what to do next. Specific guidance, built on what actually happened this week.

UNDERSTAND WHAT YOUR BODY IS TELLING YOU
Raw numbers are not insight. Wellness Project turns them into answers. Fit Score rolls training, recovery, sleep, and nutrition into one daily number. Training Load shows how hard the week really was and whether it is climbing too fast. Muscle Fatigue maps which muscle groups are ready and which need rest. NSI, your Normalized Strength Index, compares your estimated one-rep maxes to the standard for your bodyweight, age, and sex, so every PR moves a number that matters. Sleep score and consistency show whether your nights are restoring you. TDEE and calorie balance tell you if you are eating for the goal you set. HRV and resting heart rate trends flag recovery slipping before you feel it. Set a real goal, a bodyweight, a lift, a weekly mileage, and track it with progress your coaches can see and adjust.

MEET YOUR TEAM
Jamie Reyes builds and logs your strength sessions. Elias Kiptoo coaches your runs and reads your splits, cadence, and power. Casey Mills handles nutrition. Lauryn Britt works around injuries and keeps you training. Evelyn Cross plays the long game: longevity and aging well. Max Kline connects HRV, sleep, and recovery signals. Rex Dalton plans for hypertrophy and physique. Atlas Mercer designs the whole protocol. Ask any of them anything in plain language and they answer from your data, not a template.

Tell a coach something once and they remember it: you travel most weeks, your gym has no squat rack, you want feedback blunt. Nothing is saved until you approve it.

CONNECT EVERYTHING YOU ALREADY USE
Apple Health, Health Connect, Fitbit, Oura, WHOOP, Withings, Polar, Ultrahuman, Hevy, Liftosaur, Wyze scales, and more connect directly. Steps, sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, workouts, nutrition, hydration, weight, body composition, and more flow in automatically, and anything you log yourself always wins. Every synced workout opens a full detail view with heart rate, intensity, and effort.

LOG IN SECONDS
Describe a meal or workout in plain language and it lands in your log. Scan a barcode or a nutrition label. Pick photos from your camera roll and the app finds the meals in them. Save go-to meals and workouts and log them again in one tap.

SEE THE WHOLE PICTURE
Recovery Protein tracks the meals that matter after a workout. Vital Signs charts blood oxygen, breathing rate, temperature, blood pressure, glucose, and more from supported devices. Runners and cyclists get their own views. Customize the dashboard to show the views you care about. Friend challenges and streaks keep you showing up.

USE IT FROM YOUR AI OF CHOICE
Wellness Project works inside Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Mistral Le Chat, Gemini, and more. Log a workout, check your macros, or ask your coaches a question without opening the app.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Sign in with Google or Apple. A biometric lock keeps your health data private even when your phone is unlocked. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. Available in 20 languages.

Wellness Project is a personal logging and analysis tool, not a medical service. Nothing in this app, including AI advisor responses, insights, scores, or suggestions, constitutes medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making any health, nutrition, or training decisions.

Meet Felix, the first AI journaling companion that gets to know you over time. Felix is always by your side, ready to listen and offer guidance as you navigate life's ups and downs.

Ever feel like your own worst critic? Felix is there to help you build a positive mindset and push back on you when you're too hard on yourself. When things are looking up, we help celebrate the good times and appreciate the little moments. You'll never feel alone in your journey towards mental wellness.

Ready to gain clarity on your thoughts and emotions, pursue personal growth, and improve your mental well-being? Build a rewarding self-care routine with the help of KnownWell. Our approach combines the benefits of journaling and therapy with AI to provide you with:

DAILY INSIGHTS

Each day, you'll receive a message from Felix, offering support and encouragement tailored to your needs. These daily doses of motivation will help you stay focused on your goals and celebrate your achievements.

PERSONALIZED PROMPTS

MOOD TRACKING

Understand what factors impact your happiness with advanced mood tracking and AI sentiment analysis. KnownWell helps you identify the people, places, and activities that influence your mood, so you can make informed decisions about your life.

ASK YOUR JOURNAL

Want to know what moments have had the biggest impact on your mental health? Or what you can do to be happier? KnownWell's "Ask" feature pulls these insights from your journal, providing you with actionable advice and personalized recommendations.

THE SCIENCE OF HAPPINESS

Learn about positive psychology, cognitive behavioral therapy, and other evidence-based tools to help you live a more fulfilling life. Our lessons are designed to educate and empower you, so you can make lasting changes to your mental well-being.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Most health apps give everyone the same advice. TRIGR gives you yours.

TRIGR reads your EPLIMO genetic report, your blood work and your gut microbiome report, then coaches you from what is actually in them. The same question gets a different answer for a different body.

COACHING BUILT ON YOUR OWN DATA
TRIGR AI holds your genetics, your latest blood markers, your gut profile and what you did today. Ask it anything in plain language and the answer is drawn from your traits, your numbers and your habits - not from a generic article.

MY BIOLOGY
Upload an EPLIMO genetic report, a blood report or a gut microbiome report. TRIGR reads each one and explains it trait by trait and marker by marker: what it says, why it matters, and the food, movement and sleep habits it points to. Every report you add sharpens the coaching.

30-SECOND FACE SCAN
Hold your phone still and look at the camera. TRIGR estimates heart rate, heart-rate variability and stress from tiny colour changes in your skin. No wearable needed. These are wellness estimates, not clinical readings.

AI TRAINER
Prop up your phone and train. TRIGR follows your form with on-device pose tracking, counts your reps, times your holds, calls out corrections and coaches you through the set out loud. 17 exercises across cardio, upper body, lower body and core. The video stays on your phone.

AI DIETITIAN AND FOOD SCAN
Answer a few questions and TRIGR builds a meal plan around your goal, your genetics, your blood report and what you actually like eating. Photograph a plate and it names the dishes and estimates calories and macros, grounded in an India-first food database of around 250 dishes. At the end of the day you get an honest verdict on how the day went.

TRIGR BREATHE
Guided breathing that opens with your measured stress level, walks you through Calm (4-7-8), Box or Coherence, then invites you to scan again and watch your own number move.

BIOHACK PROTOCOL
An in-app guide to the nine therapies offered at Vieroots Biohack Centres - nutritional IV drips, ozone, hydrogen, red light, infrared sauna, cold plunge, EMS suit, EMS bed and PEMF mat. Read what each one involves and the screening it needs. These are in-person wellness services delivered by qualified practitioners at a Vieroots Biohack Centre and booked separately. Nothing is offered, sold or prescribed inside this app.

TRIGR HEALTH SCORE
One number out of 100 that moves with camera-verified training, logged meals, your face scan, hydration, movement and sleep. Effort counts; self-reporting alone does not.

DISCOVERIES
Each week TRIGR studies your own data and reveals patterns you would not spot yourself.

BUILT FOR INDIA
South Indian, North Indian and regional dishes recognised properly, with an India-first nutrition database behind every scan. Your day rolls over at your local midnight, wherever you live.

IPHONE AND IPAD
TRIGR adapts its navigation to the screen it is on, with a sidebar layout on larger displays instead of a stretched phone screen.

FOR EPLIMO MEMBERS
Already tested with Vieroots? Upload your EPLIMO report once. TRIGR reads it trait by trait, and every answer you get after that is shaped by it.

YOUR DATA
Your health data is yours. We never sell it. You can permanently delete your account and everything in it from inside the app, at any time.

IMPORTANT
TRIGR provides preventive-health and wellness guidance and education. It is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition, and it is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Face-scan values are camera-based estimates, not clinical measurements. Always consult a qualified doctor before acting on anything you see here, particularly anything involving medication.

TRIGR is published by Vieroots Wellness Solutions Private Limited and operated by Vieroots Wellness Private Limited.

Anima is a calm, private companion for a woman's intimate wellness — a space to understand your body, track your pleasure, and grow your connection with yourself.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Intimate Session — a mindful timer for moments alone or with a partner. With Apple Watch, see your live heart rate and calories during the session, then capture how it felt with a short reflection.

• Moments & Calendar — log intimate moments in seconds: type, duration, intensity, and optional cycle marks (period, fertile days). Your month becomes a quiet map of your life.

• Mood Check-in — answer one question a day: "What does your body say today?" Choose a state, set the intensity, add a private note. Ten seconds that build real self-knowledge.

• Breath Practice — voice-guided breathing with a living orb: inhale as it grows, exhale as it softens. From box breathing to kapalabhati with real retention rounds, five minutes at a time.

• AI Dream Journal — write down a dream and receive a thoughtful, personalized reading that connects its imagery to your recent rhythms, mood, and cycle phase. Reflect, save, return.

• A 30-Day Journey — one level a day through a classic text on desire, read as philosophy rather than instruction. Each level pairs a short article with a hand-picked film and song. The first six levels are free.

• Statistics — your patterns over weeks, months, and a year: activity, timing, balance, mood–cycle correlations, and heart-rate charts from Watch sessions. Not a scoreboard — a mirror.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• Face ID app lock, including in the app switcher
• Explicit consent before any AI processing — and you can decline
• Your data is never used for advertising and never sold
• Delete your account and every record, any time, in one place

ANIMA PREMIUM

The core is free forever: moments, calendar, mood check-ins, basic statistics, six journey levels, and one AI dream reading. Premium unlocks unlimited AI readings, weekly AI insights, advanced statistics and patterns, and journey levels 7–30.

record.name: Memotive: AI Wellness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Memotive is the AI health coach that never forgets. Every conversation, every meal, every goal — your coach remembers it all and uses it to give you guidance that gets more personal over time.

COACHING THAT KNOWS YOU
Unlike generic fitness apps, Memotive learns who you are. Your coach remembers your dietary restrictions, your injury history, your schedule, and your preferences. Mention a sore knee on Monday, and your coach adjusts your workout suggestion on Thursday — without you having to repeat yourself.

SNAP A PHOTO, GET THE BREAKDOWN
Take a photo of any meal and get an instant nutrition breakdown — calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Works with home-cooked meals, restaurant plates, nutrition labels, and menus. Just snap and your coach handles the rest.

TRACK WITHOUT THE TEDIUM
No more scrolling through food databases. Just tell your coach what you ate in plain language, or send a photo. Memotive logs it, tracks your macros, and keeps you on pace toward your goals — all through natural conversation.

HEALTH INSIGHTS THAT MATTER
Connect Apple Health to bring in your steps, sleep, heart rate, and workouts. Your coach spots patterns you might miss — like how your sleep quality drops after late meals, or how your energy correlates with hydration.

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
Track your transformation with progress photos. Before-and-after comparisons, photo timelines, and body composition trends help you see what the scale can’t show.

YOUR COACH, YOUR STYLE
Name your coach, set the coaching style you prefer — encouraging, direct, balanced, or tough love. Your coach adapts to how you respond best.

WHAT’S INCLUDED
• Unlimited AI coaching conversations
• Meal photo analysis with instant nutrition data
• Apple Health integration (steps, sleep, HR, workouts)
• Progress photo tracking with visual timeline
• Personalized nutrition targets and daily tracking
• Smart coaching notifications
• 7-day free trial

PRIVACY FIRST
Your conversations are encrypted and never used to train AI models. Your health data is never sold or shared. You can export or delete your data at any time.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Memotive offers auto-renewable subscriptions:
• Monthly: $19.99/month after 7-day free trial
• Annual: $99.99/year after 7-day free trial
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://emberonix.com/projects/memotive/terms
Privacy Policy: https://emberonix.com/projects/memotive/privacy

Memotive — a coach who never forgets.

Combining preventive health tools, activity tracking, nutrition support, mental wellbeing resources and convenient healthcare access, BookDoc supports you in taking charge of your wellbeing every day.

From tracking your daily activity and meals to connecting with healthcare professionals, BookDoc brings together the tools, insights and services you need to support your health journey — all in one app.

Activity Tracking & Rewards
• Sync and track your activity data with compatible health devices and platforms, including Apple Health, Garmin and Fitbit
• Join virtual wellness challenges that turn everyday movement into engaging experiences
• Unlock rewards from a wide range of partner merchants as you achieve monthly step goals

AI Meal Tracker
• Track your meals effortlessly by simply snapping a photo of your food
• Receive AI-powered calorie and macronutrient breakdowns, including carbohydrates, protein and fat
• Get AI-powered traffic light meal ratings and nutrition feedback validated by certified dietitians

Mind Health Tools
• Understand your mental wellbeing through evidence-based assessments
• Track your mood and journal your thoughts to identify patterns in your emotions
• Access interactive tools designed to support overall wellbeing

Health Tracking & Monitoring
• Track and monitor key health indicators such as BMI, blood pressure, cholesterol and blood glucose
• Gain insights into your health trends and overall wellbeing

Health Coaching
• Connect with certified dietitians and psychologists through virtual coaching
• Receive personalised guidance on nutrition, lifestyle changes and mental wellbeing
• Work with health coaches to set goals, navigate challenges and make informed changes towards better health

Health Resources
• Access expert-led health articles and educational webinars
• Learn more about preventive health, nutrition, physical activity, mental wellbeing and healthy living

Healthcare Access & Marketplace
• Search and book appointments with healthcare providers
• Consult healthcare professionals remotely through teleconsultation
• Access a wide range of health services, wellness packages and exclusive offers from trusted providers

Your Complete Health Companion
Whether you are looking for an activity tracker, calorie tracker, mood tracker, wellbeing journal or a convenient way to book healthcare appointments and access teleconsultation, BookDoc brings together preventive health, everyday wellness and healthcare services in one seamless experience.

Data Protection & Privacy
BookDoc is committed to safeguarding your personal information and ensuring that your data is collected, processed and protected securely in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws. We implement appropriate measures to protect your information and maintain the confidentiality of your data. For more information, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Download BookDoc today and start building healthier habits for a healthier future.
